levels.name: Södertälje syd övre
other_names: upper station on the Igelsta bridge
levels.note: Long-distance and regional trains (SJ, Mälartåg, Snälltåget). Wikipedia: 'The upper station is located on the 2-km-long Igelsta Bridge.' SL: 'Fjärrtåg från järnvägsbron ovan stationen'. Trafikverket names the operating points 'Södertälje syd övre' and 'Södertälje syd undre' (Söu). OSM puts the upper ends of the escalators, stairs and lifts on level 1.

levels.name: Waiting hall
levels.note: Wikipedia: a central waiting hall shared by both stations, with escalators and lifts up to the upper station. OSM puts the lower ends of the escalators/stairs/lifts on level 0. Whether the hall is level with the lower platforms is not stated.

levels.name: Södertälje syd undre
levels.note: SL pendeltåg (Stockholm–Gnesta) at ground level under the bridge: two tracks, two side platforms, entrance from the south (Wikipedia). No OSM level on these platforms. Wikipedia states the lower station is 23 m below the upper one (the only height figure found; unreferenced there).

answers.question: withheld: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and tags no entrance
answers.answer: Partly settled. Entrance: OSM now has a railway=train_station_entrance (n13974157810) on the south side towards Sydgatan, and Wikipedia confirms the entrance is on the southern side. Platforms: OSM has 4 escalators, 2 stairs and 2 lifts between level 0 (waiting hall) and level 1 (upper platforms), but none tagged with which platform it reaches, and the lower (pendeltåg) platforms have no mapped way to the hall. Platform refs in OSM are 5, 6, 7, 8 plus two unnumbered platforms; no source found says which of these are upper and which lower.

open: Which track numbers are on the upper and which on the lower level: OSM has refs 5–8 and two unnumbered platforms, and no source found states the numbering per level.
Which upper platform each escalator/stair/lift reaches, and how the lower pendeltåg platforms connect to the waiting hall (stairs/lift/level): no plan or owner text.
Where Fågelsången café och kiosk and the toilets are in the building: OSM has both, but no plan places them by level.
Height: only Wikipedia's 23 m between lower and upper station; nothing for the waiting hall.
Ticket machines (SL/SJ) at the station: not in any source read.
